author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗುರುತನವನಾದರಿಸು ಗುರುತರದ ವಿಷಯವದು
ಗುರಿದಾಟೆ ಮನಮಾಡು ಗುರುವನನುಸರಿಸಿ
ಗರಿಮೆಯದು ಗುರು ನಿನ್ನ ಗುರುವಾಗೆ ರೂಪಿಸುವ
ಗುರುಗೆರಗಿ ಗುರಿಯೇರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Honour the guru’s role; it is a weighty thing;
resolve to pass beyond your goal by following the guru;
it is the guru’s greatness to shape you into a guru;
bow to the guru and climb to your goal, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The Kannada plays throughout on guru (teacher, weighty) and guri (goal). Respect the teacher, follow him beyond your own aims; a true guru’s greatness is to make a teacher of the student.
